title: Shabbir se zainab ne pucha akbar hai kaha bolo bhayya
body:
SHABBIR SE ZAINAB NE PUCHA AKBAR HAI KAHA BOLO BHAIYYA
MANNAT SE MURADAO SE MAINE ATTHARA BARAS PAALA THA JISE, KYUN AAJ WO MUJHSE ROOTH GAYA AKBAR HAI KAHA BOLO BHAIYYA
JALTA HAI JIGAR DHUNDHLI HAI NAZAR HOTE HAI KALEJE KE TUKDE, SEENE PA LAGA KIS KE BHALA AKBAR HAI KAHA BOLO BHAIYYA
JIS WAQT MADINE JAYONGI PYAARI SI DULHAN MAIN LAAONGI, MAIN BYAH RACHAAONGI USKA AKBAR HAI KAHA BOLO BHAIYYA
<<DIVIDER>>
KYUN KHAAK YE SAR PAR DAALI HAI KYA HAAL YA SHAHE AALI HAI , KYUN SAR PA NAHI HAI AMMAMA AKBAR HAI KAHA BOLO BHAIYYA
KURBAAN HO TUM PAR MAA JAYI KYA HO CHUKI RUQSAT BINAYEE , MAQTAL MEIN BATAO KYA DEKHA AKBAR HAI KAHA BOLO BHAIYYA
DETI HOON TUMHE AMMA KI QASAM KARTE HO KISKA YE MATAM , YE KHOON HAI SEENE PAR KISKA AKBAR HAI KAHA BOLO BHAIYYA
MARJAYEGI MAMTA KI MAARI BETE KE BINA WO DUKHYARI , SAR PEET TI HAI UMME LAILA AKBAR HAI KAHA BOLO BHAIYYA
<<DIVIDER>>
PHIR CHEHRE PAR ZARDI KYUN CHAAYI KYA KOI MUSIBAT PHIR AAYI, UTRA HUWA HAI KYUN PHIR CHEHRA AKBAR HAI KAHA BOLO BHAIYYA
THE SAR KO JHUKAYE SHAHE ZAMAN AANSU THE RAWAANA ANKHON SE HASAN , PARDTI RAHI ZAINAB YE NOUHA AKBAR HAI KAHA BOLO BHAIYYA
